notes.title: [Notice] Cheru leaving Playism
notes.content:
Hi All 

This is a general notice to all Playism titles. 
From June 14th onwards, I (Cheru) will no longer be Playism's community manager. After over 4 years of working passionately in Playism, I have decided to leave and change direction. I am sad that I won't be working and playing with you all as a member of Playism anymore, however, I will still be around on Steam.

Thank you everyone for the amazing communities you have built around Playism games and I hope that you will all continue to enjoy their games for years to come. 

- Cheru

notes.content:

notes.title: The Scissorwalker gets a figurine! Now on display at Comic-Con 2017!
notes.content:
“Scissorwalker”, the horror game boss to end all bosses, is coming back in figurine form! Now on display at Comic-Con 2017!

“Scissorwalker”: the terrifying and immortal monster who has caused nightmares, both figuratively and literally, for players throughout the world since the release of the PC game NightCry―the spiritual successor to the seminal Clock Tower horror game series―in March of 2016. This elusive demon is set to be made available in 1/6 scale figurine form.  

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12140957/2c110d2427b39eed5b288f36f6f314276e0b5fcf.jpg

The figurine will be manufactured by Gecco Corp., veteran makers of figurines based on a wide variety of games, including the Silent Hill series and many more. Producing the figurine will be Masahiro Ito―creator of Scissorwalker and art director of the Silent Hill series, and Hifumi Kono―director of NightCry as well as Steel Battalion and the Clock Tower series.  

Catch a sneak peek at the special exhibition currently in progress at Comic-Con in San Diego, California!  

A full-color preview sample of the figurine is currently on display at the Gecco Corp. booth (#4931) at Comic-Con 2017, being held from July 20th–23rd in San Diego, California. Pricing and release date of the figurine are currently TBD, so please stay tuned for more information.

notes.title: 4/8 NightCry Updates
notes.content:
Hi all 

We wanted to let you know that the following have been updated:

Improvements:
- How To Play is now added in the beginning of the chapter 1.
- Added auto-save points.
- Camera work improved.
- Fixed some texts.

Bugfix:
- SNS related bugs are fixed.
- Chapter2 - Misdial won't occur upon calling to Will Anderson.
- Chapter3 - Modified the escape point so that it cannot be used many times.
- Rooney will not be trapped in the bathroom anymore.
- Scissorwalker emerges normally on the stairs.

If you find anything, please let us know and we will look into fixing it.

Thank you all for your continous support on our game.

notes.title: 3/21 NightCry Updates
notes.content:
Hi all

We hope you are all enjoying NightCry. 

We wanted to let you know that the following have been updated:

Chapter 1: The disappearing service cart bug is fixed
Chapter 1: Scissorwalker won't leave the storage room bug, fixed
Chapter 2, 3: Charging your phone doesn't show a difference in remaining battery level, fixed 
Chapter 2: Smartphone light is ON at the beginning of the chapter, fixed
Player can interact with objects during QTE (Quick Time Event) bug, fixed 
Click is unresponsive immediately after camera change in Exploration Mode, fixed
Fixed a portion of text


We want to thank those who are reporting the bugs to us. If you find anything, please let us know and we will look into fixing it. Thank you to Uroboros for making a Bug Reporting Thread for us.

notes.title: Introducing the Cast
notes.content:
In anticipation of NightCry's upcoming release this spring (2016), we would like to share some information that you've surely been waiting to hear!

English Voice Cast

Hannah Grace - Monica
Jack Merluzzi - Leonard
Jenny Shima - Rooney
Jonathan Sherr - Jerome
Soness Stevens - Connie
Chris Wells  - Clerk/Eric
Barry Gjerde - Vigo
Donna Burke – Jessica, Kelly
Eric Kelso - Harry


Japanese Voice Cast

Nazuka Kaori - Monica
Koyama Rikiya - Leonard
Matsui Erina - Rooney
Mizuno Shuntarou - Jerome
Shimizu Ai - Connie
Miyano Mamoru - Frontman
Shibata Hidekatsu - Vigo
Koizumi Takao - Kelly
Itou Asuka - Jessica
Shimizu Jun - Maria
Iwazaki Yousuke - Harry, Announcements
Maihara Yume - Angie, Doll
Ogura Naohiro - Coby, Rescue Worker
Irikura Keisuke - Fat Crew Member
Naofumi Ichihashi - Newscaster
Kurisu Patora - Old Woman


Little by little, the Scissorwalker is dragging its colossal blades to your home. We hope you are ready...
